The only minor weakness is the HDMI ARC/eARC claim, which is drawn from generic Samsung soundbar support pages (sources 2-3) rather than a Q990D-specific source.

tv_display.reasoning: Claims 1-11 are well grounded in the QN90D-specific sources, with good disambiguation (e.g., noting 4K 120Hz applies to the 98-inch/2.47m variant) and good filtering of the massive nav/pricing boilerplate in Source 8. The main flaw is claim 12: Bixby/Alexa support is drawn from generic Samsung TV support pages (Sources 10-13) that never mention the QN90D, so it is an unsupported attribution to this specific product.

Only minor quibble is a few extractable details (e.g., price, model number A1289011) were skipped, but the core claim set is clean and accurate.
